identity.name: Nautilus
identity.one_liner: The 42mm white-gold Jumbo Nautilus — the watch that became the alternative to a steel 5711 when the steel allocation closed, with a 1.7x price tag and a longer waitlist.

narrative.story: When the 5711 became a five-year waitlist in 2018, collectors who would not pay grey-market premiums turned to the 5168G: same Gerald Genta case, 2.2mm larger, in 18k white gold instead of steel, with a khaki-green dial. The result: a watch that holds its value because the entry Nautilus is no longer available. The 5168G is the closest the brand came to a publicly-purchasable Jumbo after the original 3700/1A was retired.
narrative.collector_notes: The 5168G wears smaller than the 42.2mm suggests because of the bezel proportions. Check the lume application on the hands — Patek is conservative, so the lume is functional, not theatrical.
